tests.name: Existing runtime schema accepts all bounded startup projections
Normalization preserves display names and detects domain, alias and identifier collisions
Pinned graph and overlay remain unchanged and denominators match
Claim provenance is complete, uniquely identified and excludes rights-held sources
Projection field sources retain founding milestones and country provenance
Funding amounts, dates, component sources and participant relationships are consistent
Material conflict and null regressions remain conservative
Counts reconcile without equating candidates, rounds, participants or survey totals
Bounded evidence capture covers every accepted claim exactly once
Resume checkpoint is deterministic, skips reviewed candidates and rejects changed inputs

limitations: Offline structural and provenance checks; semantic source review is documented separately. No production ingestion, crawler approval or deployment.
